title: Potential Economic Impact of Fixing the Inverted Customs Duty Structure: The Case of Indian Viscose Fibers

summary.about: The effect of removing India’s tariff disadvantage on imported pulp used to make viscose fibre.
summary.audience: Textile and customs policymakers, viscose producers and trade analysts.
summary.method: Uses a GTAP multi-sector computable general equilibrium (CGE) model to simulate correction of the inverted duty structure. Counterfactual outcomes are evaluated against a calibrated baseline through sectoral output, trade, factor-income, and welfare channels.
summary.insights: The reform is estimated to raise Indian GDP by about $18 million and exports by about $10.75 million. These are scenario-conditioned comparative responses rather than unconditional forecasts.
